title: Settling a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan in Full
content:
# Settling a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans in Full

**Finance desk request record note.** A customer who wishes to clear a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan in full asks the finance desk for the figure that settles it. The figure is quoted against the plan as it stands at the handling date, and the settlement itself closes the plan: the money is taken as a settled payment on the plan's billing history, what the plan still owes is set to nothing, the day of settlement is recorded as the day the plan closed and as the day of the most recent settled payment, and the plan moves into its settled state.

## Conditions on the figure

The settlement figure is worked out only after every payment the bank has sent back unpaid on the plan carries the returned-payment charge owed against it in the billing history.

The settlement figure is worked out only after every missed payment due date printed on the plan's statements carries the lateness charge due against it in the billing history.

## The request record

The request to settle is taken on the finance desk's own request record. Settling a plan disposes of the customer's own money, so the step is the customer's to take: the desk hands it over rather than performing it.

## Invoking `confirm_plan_settlement_d71750ce`

This is a customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `confirm_plan_settlement_d71750ce` and hands it to the customer, who runs it themselves; the customer themselves commits the money and closes the plan.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `financing_plan_id` | The reference number of the promotional financing plan record the customer is clearing | An identifier, read from the financing plan lookup before the call and handed to the customer with the tool |
| `settlement_amount` | The money the customer puts up to clear the plan in full | In USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, half-up at the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; an empty value is not accepted |

**Return.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the reference number minted for the settled payment entry, the plan reference now closed, and the money taken in USD to two decimal places. That sentence naming the closed plan is what indicates the settlement has gone through and nothing further stands on the plan.

## Points of judgement

- The tool takes the figure it is given; the figure itself is worked out from the plan's records and this desk's published rules before the call.
- The parameters are values the call needs, not questions the desk is required to put to the customer.
